name: nRF52840 DK (PCA10056)
description: The reference Bluetooth LE / Thread / Zigbee board for the nRF52840: on-board J-Link OB debugger, Arduino Uno R3 headers, 1 MB flash plus 8 MB QSPI flash, USB device and NFC antenna.
notes: Two micro-USB ports: one for the J-Link OB debugger (with virtual COM port), one for the nRF52840's native USB device. Can also emulate nRF52811.
VDD defaults to 3.0 V from USB (1.7-5 V when externally powered), so IO is 3.3 V-class and not 5 V tolerant. Powered from USB, external supply, LiPo connector or CR2032 holder.

Includes an NFC antenna and an SWF RF-measurement connector. Flash total counts 1 MB internal plus the 8 MB on-board QSPI flash. Size, GPIO count and price (DigiKey, Nordic does not list one) are approximate.
